results.remarks: Turnkey single-level condo situated two blocks west of Lake Avenue and two blocks south of Colorado Blvd. This recently renovated corner unit, built in 1988, offers a superb location in the heart of Pasadena. Oak Knoll Terrace is a secure and well-maintained community featuring abundant mature trees, lush planters, and a community pool. The neighborhood includes a mix of residential and commercial properties, offering close proximity to public transportation, shops, restaurants, and markets, as well as the California Institute of Technology, Pasadena Playhouse, and Old Pasadena. This move-in-ready, 2-bedroom, 2-bathroom unit includes two large balconies, providing approximately 300 SF+/- of private outdoor space. The unit has two side-by-side parking spaces in the secure community garage and in-unit laundry. Both bedrooms have large closets with direct access to the spacious private balcony. The property blends functional design elements—such as 9-foot ceilings, calming natural light, ample room sizes, luxury vinyl plank floors, and plentiful storage—while presenting a clean and contemporary aesthetic. The indoor-outdoor flow of this 1,250 SF+/- (per LA County Assessor) one-level property make it feel larger than the SF number suggests. Light and bright, this unit recently underwent substantial cosmetic upgrades, including new interior paint, new recessed lighting, new lighting fixtures, and new plumbing fixtures. Other aspects of this property that will satisfy selective buyers include the decorative fireplace, an extra-large dining room, and new quartz countertops in the kitchen and bathrooms. This unit also comes with all appliances included: stainless-steel refrigerator, dishwasher, microwave, and stove, as well as a stackable washer and dryer in a hallway closet. The monthly HOA covers exterior maintenance, roof, water, trash, sewer, gardener, elevator, earthquake insurance, community insurance, and professional management. Pets are also permitted - two animals, dogs and/or cats are welcome. Easy access was a priority when this building was designed because the unit can be reached without going up a single step, via elevator access from the garage or the ramp located at the front of the building. Whether you are looking for a wonderful starter home, a modern pied-a-terre, or a comfortable space during retirement, this unit can work for all buyers.

results.remarks: A true live/work zoned residence in the heart of Old Town Pasadena  a designation few properties in this market can claim. This top-floor loft at the historic Raymond Renaissance combines soaring two-story ceilings, sophisticated industrial architecture, and burnt emerald stained concrete flooring for a cohesive, gallery-like aesthetic rarely found in traditional condos. The main level opens to an expansive living and dining space anchored by a serious home-cook's kitchen with granite counters, tile backsplash, and stainless appliances  equally suited to entertaining or hosting a client meeting. Upstairs, two bedrooms include a flexible loft-style suite ideal as a private office, studio, or creative workspace, offering the rare ability to genuinely live and work from one address without compromise. Location is the exclamation point: directly across from Memorial Park, steps to the Sunday farmers market, two blocks to the restaurants, boutiques, and energy of Colorado Blvd, and one block to the Metro Gold Line for an effortless connection into downtown LA. A 98 Walk Score reflects how close daily life sits  coffee, dinner, culture, transit  just beyond your door. This is Old Town Pasadena living for those who want their home to work as hard as they do: a private outdoor patio to unwind, an architecturally distinct floor plan to entertain in, and a live/work designation that turns square footage into genuine flexibility. Opportunities like this at Raymond Renaissance surface rarely.

This beautifully maintained 2-bedroom, 2-bathroom condo offers approximately 982 sq. ft. of comfortable living space with an open floor plan, 9-ft ceilings, recessed lighting, crown moldings, and abundant natural light. The inviting living room features a cozy fireplace and opens to the dining area and updated kitchen with granite countertops, beautiful cabinetry, stainless-steel appliances, and a gas range. A convenient in-unit stackable washer and dryer is located in the kitchen closet.  The two spacious bedroom suites are positioned on opposite sides of the unit, each with a private full bathroom and walk-in closet, which provides excellent privacy. Step onto the private balcony to enjoy your morning coffee or unwind.   Additional features include central air and heat, ample storage, and two assigned subterranean parking spaces with elevator access. Guest parking is also available. Community amenities include a pool and spa, fitness center, sauna, BBQ area, and a recreation/media room, perfect for relaxing or entertaining.  It is ideally located near the Pasadena Playhouse, Playhouse Village, Paseo Colorado, Old Pasadena, Lake Avenue shopping and dining, the Metro Gold Line, and the 210 Freeway.
Move-in ready and a wonderful opportunity to enjoy the best of Pasadena living!

Welcome to unit 403 at 176 N. Catalina Avenue, a stunning 3-bedroom, 2.5-bath luxury condominium offering 1,622 square feet of thoughtfully designed living space. Situated on the top floor, this beautiful residence combines modern elegance, quality craftsmanship, and an exceptional Pasadena location just moments from Caltech, Pasadena City College, Old Pasadena, South Lake Avenue, premier dining, shopping, and convenient freeway access. Designed for both style and functionality, the open-concept floor plan features a gourmet kitchen with beautiful quartz countertops, Whirlpool stainless steel appliances, and an LG washer and dryer. The spacious primary suite offers a large walk-in closet and a luxurious full bath, while the additional bedrooms provide comfortable accommodations for family, guests, or a home office. HOA dues are just $499/month and include trash service, landscape maintenance, and community security.
Enjoy sophisticated new construction, luxury finishes, and the convenience of top-floor living in one of Pasadena's most desirable locations.

results.remarks: Inspired by Bauhaus architecture, Hudson Terrace is a modern luxury penthouse built in 2009 in Pasadena's vibrant South Lake Avenue District. Ideally positioned across from the Pasarroyo Business Complex and 1 block from dining, shopping, and fitness--including Trader Joe's, Erewhon, Macy's, and LA Fitness--this front-facing penthouse offers exceptional urban convenience in one of the city's most desirable neighborhoods. The exterior features a Trespa Meteon rain shield system, ivory brick and stucco detailing, sandblasted glass balcony railings, and expansive floor-to-ceiling windows that fill the home with natural light. This residence provides a loft-like living experience with a dramatic living room showcasing resurfaced hardwood floors, a precast stone corner fireplace, French Deco capiz shell sconces, custom Hunter Douglas roller blinds, and floor-to-ceiling dual-paned glass doors opening to a balcony overlooking oak-lined Hudson Ave. Updated electrical circuitry and Lutron Caseta dimmer-controlled recessed lighting enhance the modern ambiance. An elegant guest bath with marble counters and intricate tilework completes the main level. The gourmet kitchen features sleek Italian-designed cabinetry, honed black granite countertops, a Bertazzoni gas range and hood, Bosch stainless steel appliances, filtered water at both sink & refrigerator, a walk-in storage room, utility closet, and a dedicated balcony with stainless FireCraft smoker grill. The primary suite offers vaulted ceilings, remote-controlled roller shades, a craftsman wood ceiling fan, a gas fireplace, and a custom Dall'Agnese walk-in closet. The spa bath includes a 6 jet soaking tub,  floor-to-ceiling glass shower, double Duravit sinks with Kohler polished nickel fixtures, and imported stone. A second bedroom with a mirrored wall functions as a guest room, gym, or office, with an adjacent bath featuring a spacious travertine and mosaic steam shower. A private rooftop terrace crowns the penthouse, offering sweeping city & mountain views. Additional highlights include 4 balconies, 2 side-by-side parking spaces near the elevator and storage room. Upgrades: Nest climate control, Lutron Caseta lighting, Hunter Douglas blinds, Restoration Hardware lighting, Bosch refrigerator,  LG ThinQ washer/dryer. This pristine residence is moments from Pasadena's iconic: Caltech, ArtCenter, Langham, Huntington Library, Norton Simon, Old Town, Playhouse & Rose Bowl.

results.remarks:
Among Pasadena's most sought-after single-story condominiums, this expansive 2-bedroom, 2-bath residence embodies the very best of contemporary living. Terra Bella has earned its reputation for exceptional construction and a coveted layout, designed for those who value absolute privacy paired with effortless ease. This prized second-floor home showcases warm, richly grained wood flooring, graceful crown molding, custom cabinetry, and classic arched windows throughout. A pair of fireplaces anchors the home — one anchoring the living room, the other adding intimate warmth to the primary suite, which opens to a generous en-suite bath complete with a standalone jacuzzi tub, a separate water closet, a walk-in shower, and dual vanities. Additional touches include zoned air conditioning, a tankless water heater, indoor laundry hookup, and custom-built walk-in closets.
The layout flows from a welcoming living room into a bright, generously sized gourmet kitchen centered on a large island, alongside a dedicated formal dining room built for seamless entertaining. Head up to the rooftop, where open-air lounges, a pool-sized jacuzzi, a fully outfitted gym, private cabanas, a fire pit, and BBQ stations await. Privacy is woven into the building's very design, with just two homes per floor behind fob-secured access. Rounding out the offering is a ground-floor clubhouse featuring conference space, a lounge, and a kitchen and bathrooms set aside exclusively for residents, along with two prized side-by-side parking spots — #39 and #40 — and a dedicated storage unit.
Set within easy reach of Old Town Pasadena, the Pasadena Convention Center, the Paseo's upscale shops, Whole Foods, Trader Joe's, and countless acclaimed restaurants and everyday conveniences, this is an exceptional opportunity in refined luxury — not to be overlooked.

results.remarks:
Experience dramatic contemporary living in Residence 103 at 176 N. Catalina Avenue, a beautifully designed 3-bedroom, 3.5-bath luxury condominium offering 1,641 square feet of thoughtfully crafted living space. The spectacular living room showcases soaring two-story ceilings that fill the home with natural light, complemented by a striking designer stone chandelier that serves as a stunning architectural centerpiece. Expansive windows perfectly frame the beautifully landscaped grounds, creating a seamless connection between the elegant interior and the lush outdoor setting. Located within an exclusive collection of brand-new luxury residences, this exceptional home combines sophisticated design, premium finishes, and an unbeatable Pasadena location just moments from Caltech, Pasadena City College, Old Pasadena, South Lake Avenue, premier dining, shopping, and convenient freeway access. The spacious multi-level floor plan is designed for effortless entertaining and comfortable everyday living. The open-concept main living area flows into a gourmet kitchen featuring elegant quartz countertops, Whirlpool stainless steel appliances, and an LG washer and dryer. All three bedrooms feature their own private en-suite bathrooms, while a convenient powder room on the main level is perfect for guests. The luxurious primary suite offers a spacious walk-in closet and a spa-inspired bath, while a generous private patio extends the living space outdoors.
Every level is equipped with its own dedicated air conditioning system and a convenient storage closet. Additional premium features include thick dual-pane glass for enhanced comfort and sound insulation, a soft water system, and an EV charging outlet for one of the two assigned parking spaces. Residents enjoy a secure gated community with beautifully landscaped grounds, a community BBQ area, bike racks in the garage, 17 security cameras, and an underground rainwater collection and pumping system. HOA dues are just $499/month and include trash service, landscape maintenance, and community security.

A striking blend of architectural elegance, luxury finishes, and modern convenience, Residence 103 offers an exceptional opportunity to own a brand-new home in one of Pasadena's most desirable neighborhoods.

results.remarks: This light-filled, tastefully upgraded condo in Pasadena offers 2 bedrooms, 2 bathrooms, and a generously sized balcony. Nestled in a quiet corner on the second floor, this corner-unit home is in excellent move-in condition and combines comfort with style. The spacious living room features warm laminate wood flooring and an open, airy atmosphere, enhanced by abundant natural light streaming through large glass sliding doors. Step outside to the expansive balcony—an ideal space to relax and take in the scenic mountain views. The updated kitchen showcases the owner’s thoughtful upgrades, including sleek white cabinetry and stainless steel appliances that bring a modern, clean aesthetic to the heart of the home. A newly installed HVAC system, completed in 2025, provides added comfort and energy efficiency. A hallway lined with a sliding closet and built-in cabinetry provides ample additional storage. Both bedrooms offer carpeted floors, and the bathrooms are immaculately maintained. The primary bedroom includes a walk-in closet and an ensuite bath for added privacy and convenience. Community amenities include a gated pool, same-floor laundry, trash chute, two secure garage parking spaces, and a controlled-access lobby. Enjoy easy access to Jefferson Park, Pasadena City College, the Rose Bowl, and the vibrant shops and restaurants along Colorado Boulevard and Lake Street.

results.remarks:
Residence #202 at 150 S Oak Knoll offers clean modern living in the heart of Pasadena’s Playhouse Village. The home is bright and comfortable, with warm wood tones, understated contemporary finishes, and an easy sense of calm. The kitchen is clean and well finished, the sleek wood-grain cabinetry, premium stainless appliances, quartz countertop and a full-height backsplash, connecting easily to the dinning and living areas. From the dining area, olive trees and distant palms frame the view.
The primary suite features a walk-in closet, dual sinks, and an oversized glass-enclosed shower. A quiet den opens directly to the balcony, creating a comfortable spot for reading, working, or meditation. The guest bedroom is spacious, and the home also includes an individual laundry area. Wide-plank hardwood flooring for living area, and large-format porcelain tiles in the bathrooms keep the finishes clean and simple. 



The spectacular 4th and 5th floor rooftop garden gives this property its real distinction. With outdoor seating, barbecue areas, dining spaces, fire pit, and open views toward the city and the San Gabriel Mountains, the rooftop becomes a natural extension of the home — a place for morning coffee, sunset dinners, quiet evenings, or casual gatherings above Pasadena. Set within a newly built 19-home community, this residence offers modern interiors, generous rooftop spaces, and a rooftop life above the city.

results.remarks: Welcome to The Montana, one of Pasadena's most prestigious full-service luxury residences, ideally positioned along iconic Colorado Boulevard. This exceptional 3rd-floor corner condo offers refined living, sweeping views over Paseo Colorado & the vibrant cityscape beyond. A grand entry with tray ceilings & refined detailing sets the tone for this expansive open-concept living space. Hardwood floors, recessed lighting & an oversized gas fireplace with a raised stone hearth create a warm, sophisticated setting. A wall of windows fills the room with natural light, framing dynamic city views. A flexible secondary living space with sliding solid wood doors offers the perfect setting for relaxing, a large home office, or an additional dining area. The chef's kitchen is beautifully appointed, featuring stone countertops, a center island & a suite of high-end appliances, including a Sub-Zero refrigerator, Wolf double ovens, a warming drawer, a microwave & a 6-burner cooktop. Custom cabinetry with soft-close features, built-ins & pantry storage completes the space. The west wing hosts 2 generously sized bedrooms. results.remarks: Luxury. Prestige. Security. Location. These defining qualities converge flawlessly at The Montana, widely regarded as Pasadena's most distinguished address.  Ideally situated in the vibrant heart of legendary Colorado Boulevard admidst celebrated architecture, world-class shopping and dining, the Montana is ultimate refinement and discretion, and Unit 203 is simply one of the best units!  Meticulously newly-remodeled with uncompromising attention to detail, this exceptional one-level home embodies timeless elegance and modern luxury. One of 28 exclusive residences, and the only one with a rare 550sf terrace that spans the width of the unit, this stunning home offers tranquil, elevated indoor and outdoor living. An exquisite entry foyer sets the tone, opening to voluminous living spaces crowned by 10' ceilings, brand-new wide-planked wood floors, curated wall coverings, bespoke lighting fixtures, new paint, designer window treatment and quality carpet. The foyer beckons guests into a spectacular living and dining room, anchored by a handsome hand-crafted fireplace and illuminated by a tall wall of floor-to-ceiling windows that frame lush greenery vistas. Glass French doors seamlessly open from every room and spill onto the airy outdoor terrace creating a harmonious indoor-outdoor flow, perfect for lounging, entertaining, morning coffee or evening aperitifs under the open sky. The gourmet kitchen is a chef's dream with its striking black-and-white marble countertops, premium Wolf and Sub-Zero appliances, and a charming dining nook for casual everyday meals. Beyond the main living area, a cool media room offers an indulgent space for relaxation, complete with padded walls, a wet bar, refrigerator and cigar humidor. An adjacent office provides a quiet workspace with custom built-in desks and shelving. A fully-equipped laundry room, plus a wine room with a built-in fridge, connects with the discreet rear entrance to this unit. Three sumptuous, spacious en-suite bedrooms provide the ultimate sanctuary for rest and relaxation, each thoughtfully appointed with custom closets and opulent bathrooms that evoke a spa-like serenity. Residents of The Montana enjoy an unparalleled array of amenities including a gorgeous library lounge, state-of-art gym with continuous-surge pool, two private gardens, 3 private parking spaces, 20 guest spaces and a 24-hour concierge service. Superbly finished to perfection, this is the quintessential home for today's discerning buyer.

results.remarks: PASADENA - Experience the pinnacle of sophisticated city living in the heart of downtown Pasadena, where this opulent apartment-style residence offers panoramic views, high style and a stellar location. One of only 28 luxury condos in The Montana, a highly sought-after amenity-rich mixed-use building, this extraordinary single-level home hosts four bedrooms, and office/den with wet bar, and four- and one-half baths in approximately 4,135 square feet. Every detail is superb, including custom wall treatments, contemporary designer lighting fixtures, wood and natural stone flooring, 10' ceilings, solid stained-wood interior doors, custom paint, and a gallery-style grand hall with recessed barrel ceiling treatments. City views catch the eye upon entry in the formal foyer, which leads to a fireplace-warmed great room with surround sound and a stunning solarium that frames south-facing views of city lights. Open to a casual dining room, the kitchen is top-tier and features granite countertops with full backsplash, dark-stained wood cabinetry, a peninsula bar, island, pantry, and stainless-steel Wolf and Sub-Zero appliances including a six-burner cooktop with griddle. Secondary bedrooms are spacious, with some including an ensuite bath. For the ultimate escape, the primary suite reveals two baths with stone surrounds, and two walk-in closets with built-ins. Three parking spaces are reserved in The Montana’s secured subterranean parking garage. Introduced by a dramatic atrium-style entrance, The Montana reveals a private world of modern luxury, with public spaces adorned with natural finishes, artwork and an abundance of light. Residents enjoy 24-hour security, a full gym, an indoor pool and peaceful lounge. Relish front-row views from your living room of the world-famous Rose Parade as it proceeds along Colorado Boulevard, part of Historic Route 66. Paseo Colorado is directly across the street and offers an open-air setting with restaurants, shops and theaters. Ruth’s Chris Steakhouse is only a block away, and Old Town Pasadena, city hall, parks, excellent schools, the famed Pasadena Playhouse, museums, freeways and the Pasadena Convention Center are all close to home.
